title: Anthropic asked a priest for help
blurb: A priest helped write the ethical rules for one of the most powerful AIs ever built.
body:
A striking footnote in AI-safety culture: a priest reportedly helped write some of the ethical rules guiding Claude — "Anthropic built one of the most powerful AI models on Earth, then asked a priest for help."

Whatever the specifics, it captures a real theme: as models grow more capable, alignment work increasingly draws on moral philosophy, theology and the humanities — not just ML.

SOURCE · Evolving AI, LinkedIn.
